metaDescription: TriCity Concrete Sealing won our 2026 Concrete Sealing & Resurfacing award for Kitchener, Ontario. 500+ projects, 5-year workmanship warranty.
summary: TriCity Concrete Sealing protects driveways, patios, stamped surfaces and commercial floors across Kitchener, Waterloo and Cambridge with premium UV-resistant sealers. With over 500 completed projects and 8 years of experience, the company backs its sealing work with a 5-year workmanship warranty.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: TriCity Concrete Sealing offers driveway, patio, stamped concrete, walkway and exposed aggregate sealing, along with commercial sealing. Covering exposed aggregate and commercial floors alongside residential driveways shows a broader material range than a company that only handles plain broom-finish concrete.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: The company uses premium UV-resistant sealers and emphasizes meticulous surface preparation, on the basis that sealers bond properly and last longer when the surface underneath is properly cleaned and prepped first. With over 500 completed projects and 8 years of experience, and a 5-year workmanship warranty, the business positions itself around durability rather than the cheapest possible sealing job.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: One reviewer said their driveway, sealed the previous spring, still looked new and survived a difficult winter without a single crack or stain. Another described the crew as on-time and professional, and said the colour on their stamped concrete patio noticeably improved after sealing.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The company serves Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and the wider Waterloo Region. Homeowners further from this core Tri-Cities area should confirm coverage before booking.

faq.a: TriCity Concrete Sealing was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top concrete sealing specialist serving the Kitchener area, based on public services, reviews and track record, with no fee for consideration or winning.
